title: locus-pi extension manifest
description: The declared public contract of one default extension. scripts/check-extension-manifests.ts validates every manifest referenced by package.json#pi.extensions against this file, so a field added here without a consumer, or an enum value no shipped manifest uses, is a defect. Each property description names the consumer that reads it.

id.description: Extension identity; must equal the directory name. Read by extensions/agents/catalog.ts, scripts/audit-sources.ts and scripts/check-extension-manifests.ts.

agent.description: The bundled agent profile this extension owns. Read by extensions/agents/catalog.ts, which resolves the profile and rejects description drift against its frontmatter.

name.description: Bundled profile name; a file of this name must exist under .agents/agents/.

description.description: Published catalog line; must equal the profile frontmatter description.

ownershipStatus.description: Who owns the implementation. Read by scripts/audit-sources.ts, which demands completed review metadata from adapted extensions.

runtimeRequirements.description: Host APIs and lifecycle events the extension needs. Reviewer and documentation contract; nothing executes it. Read by tests/extensions/workflows/fusion-tool.test.ts and documented in docs/extensions.md.

stateUsed.description: Session and on-disk state the extension reads or writes. Reviewer and documentation contract; nothing executes it. Read by tests/extensions/workflows/fusion-tool.test.ts and documented in docs/extensions.md.

provides.description: The public surface. Read by tests/contracts/extensions/runtime-registration.test.ts (commands must equal live registration), tests/contracts/host/selective-package-loading.test.ts (tools, commands and hooks must equal what the host loads) and tests/contracts/docs/extension-reference.test.ts (the docs/extensions.md row).

uiLifecycle.description: Per-surface UI and persistence taxonomy for review. Nothing executes it; scripts/check-extension-manifests.ts requires every entry to name a surface this manifest declares under provides. Omitted by extensions that expose no command and no tool.

permissions.description: Declared capabilities. Reviewer and documentation contract: the package grants no capability from this field and the host is not sandboxed by it. Documented in docs/extensions.md and docs/architecture.md.

risk.description: Review severity, not a sandbox guarantee. Read by tests/contracts/docs/extension-reference.test.ts, which pins it to the docs/extensions.md row.

docsPath.description: Co-located manual. Read by tests/contracts/docs/extension-reference.test.ts and tests/docs/public-docs.test.ts; scripts/check-extension-manifests.ts requires the file to exist and to be packaged through package.json#files.

sourceAuditPath.description: Link to an internal source-audit note. scripts/audit-sources.ts requires null on every published manifest, so a fork that keeps such notes has a place to declare them without shipping them.

tests.description: The evidence that the implementation matches this contract. scripts/check-extension-manifests.ts and tests/contracts/docs/extension-reference.test.ts require every path to exist.

review.description: Review metadata. Read by scripts/audit-sources.ts, which requires a named reviewer and date on every adapted extension.

status.description: The only status a published manifest may carry; unreviewed work does not enter package.json#pi.extensions.

source.description: How the implementation was obtained. scripts/audit-sources.ts treats copy-after-audit as adapted.

name.description: A tool name, or the top-level word of a command, declared under provides.
